transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, July 28. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'I am a street fighter': Combative Pradhan arrives in Parliament to a rousing welcome. Former minister Dharmendra Pradhan asserted his street fighter identity after resigning from his post. He arrived in Parliament as a Member of Parliament, receiving strong support from fellow MPs. Colleagues raised slogans and offered traditional honours, showcasing solidarity with the ex-minister. This public display aimed to convey that his resignation was not a reflection of his work. India refused to take illegal migrants back as UK didn't extradite Nirav Modi: Priti Patel. Former UK Home Secretary Priti Patel stated India refused migrant returns. This refusal was linked to the UK's failure to extradite fugitive jeweler Nirav Modi. Patel expressed dismay that Modi remained in London for seven years. She believes India was angry over Britain's stance on his extradition. 'Let Sooryavanshi open with Rohit': Ex-cricketer wants Gill to bat at No.4. Former India wicketkeeper Farokh Engineer believes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi deserves an ODI call-up. He suggests the young batter should open with Rohit Sharma in the future. Engineer also proposed Shubman Gill bat at number four in the lineup. The Zimbabwe series performances have convinced Engineer of Sooryavanshi's readiness. End to Parliament impasse in sight, Lok Sabha may take up bill on exam reforms today. Parliamentary proceedings may resume Tuesday after Lok Sabha Speaker's outreach to break impasse. The government's bill on paper leaks is likely to be discussed in the lower House. A discussion on the Vande Mataram bill may begin in the Rajya Sabha. Opposition members have moved many amendment notices to the public exams bill. CWG: Sarvesh Kushare becomes 1st Indian to win silver in men's high jump. The 31-year-old national record holder cleared 2.25m to claim the silver medal. Jamaica's Romaine Beckford won gold, while England's Jack Kimani took bronze with a jump of 2.20m. 'Extra payout' to Maharashtra PSU: HDFC board slaps rupees 1 lakh fines on MD, CFO. HDFC Bank's board penalized top executives over deposit arrangements with MSRDC. The internal review found business overreach but no personal gain or mala fide intent. Top executives received nominal penalties and warning letters following the review's recommendations. This action comes as the RBI pushes boards for greater oversight and before the CEO's term ends. 'Verifying authenticity': DRDO sources on report claiming DRDO data put on dark web. Sensitive Defence Research and Development Organisation data was reportedly offered for sale. This alleged data was advertised for eight thousand dollars on the dark web. A cyber intelligence firm discovered the sensitive information during routine monitoring. The Defence Research and Development Organisation is currently verifying the authenticity of these claims. rupees 100 crore+ income club sees most entries in 4 years. Government data shows 576 individuals disclosed over rupees 100 crore income in FY2024-25. This number includes 161 new high-income earners added during the past year. Most of these super-rich taxpayers are non-salaried, reflecting past income trends. Direct tax collection's share in total revenue has significantly increased over time. Pacific island rat cleanup accidentally wipes out mosquito species too. Conservationists removed invasive rats from Palmyra Atoll, expecting native species to recover. This action unexpectedly caused the local extinction of the Asian tiger mosquito. Researchers discovered the mosquitoes heavily relied on rats for their blood meals. The removal of this key food source triggered a chain reaction on the island. Laguna Beach home bought for $16m now listed for $112m after rebuild. A Laguna Beach oceanfront estate is now on the market for $112 million. The owners invested $20 million to extensively renovate the property over two years. This remarkable residence spans 14,400 square feet and includes six bedrooms. The owners are selling as they have relocated and no longer need the large home. Canada clarifies work permit rules for international students after rejections. Canada's immigration authority has clarified international student work rules. Unauthorized work can lead to serious consequences and future permit refusals. Portage College advised protesting Indian students to seek legal counsel. Students must retain all important documents for future applications.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. MP High Court Issues Notices On Plea By In-Service Teachers Over TET. The Madhya Pradesh High Court has issued notices to the Centre and the state government on a petition challenging RTE Act provisions linked to the Supreme Court's direction to hold TET twice a year until 2028. Another Civic Blunder: Wall Seals Off Bhopal Municipal Corporation's Public Urinal In Awadhpuri. A public urinal at Vidyasagar T-junction in Bhopal's Awadhpuri has become unusable after a newly constructed wall blocked its entrance. MP Housing Board's Proposal To Increase Redevelopment Home Size By Up To 60 percent Stuck For 1.5 Years As Nearly 1,200 Families Await Relief. More than 1,200 families in old Madhya Pradesh Housing Board colonies are awaiting larger homes as a proposal to revise the redevelopment policy has remained pending for over 18 months. Indore's Aspiring Actor Saves Four Lives Through Organ Donation, Heart Airlifted To Ahmedabad. Twenty-five-year-old Gaurav Dave from Indore saved four lives and restored sight through organ donation after being declared brain dead. E-bus feeder trial begins to bridge Bhopal's Metro gap. Class VIII Pass Youth Held For Posing As Lawyer In Indore District Court. A Class VIII-pass youth was caught allegedly posing as a lawyer in the Indore District Court premises while wearing an advocate's uniform. Madhya Pradesh Uniform Civil Code: Marriage, divorce, inheritance, live-in rules Explained. 3, Including 11-Year-Old Boy, Killed In Lightning Strikes In Madhya Pradesh. Lawyer's car window smashed, bag stolen outside restaurant in Shahpura. BJP organises 'Women's Aakrosh Rally' at MVM College Ground in Bhopal. Datia bypoll: CM promises development. 5th accused with rupees 60L gold held in Jabalpur bank robbery. Metro work, monsoon turn Jawahar Chowk into daily traffic nightmare. Paras Semiconductor eyes chip facility in Madhya Pradesh, India. Lightning strikes kill 6 across MP as rain lashes state. Twisha Sharma Death Case: Bhopal Court Denies Bail To Former District Judge Giribala Singh.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Gold Holds Gain as Trump Sounds Optimism Over US-Iran Talks. Gold held a gain after President Donald Trump said the US and Iran were in talks to end the war that's stoked inflationary concerns and raised the likelihood of higher interest rates. Treasuries Rise as Elevated Yields Attract Buyers Before Fed. US Treasuries rose as the US paused strikes on Iran and oil prices fell, with an auction of the shortest-dated notes attracting buyers ahead of this week's Federal Reserve meeting. Wall Street ends mixed as investors focus on tech earnings. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 7, GRAPHIC):US STOCKS Dollar eases as oil prices fall on pause in Middle East conflict. GLOBAL-FOREX/ (UPDATE 5):FOREX US yields decline as oil plunges. USA-BONDS/ (UPDATE 2):TREASURIES Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver edge higher as easing US-Iran tensions cool oil prices. Gold and silver prices gained on 27 July, buoyed by reduced tensions in the Middle East and lower crude oil costs ahead of the US Federal Reserve's meeting. Gold rose $49 to $4,119, while silver increased by $1.50 to $60.39, reflecting a shift in investor sentiment. AstraZeneca shares climb after earnings beat estimates as cancer drug portfolio drives strong growth. Adjusted earnings per share, excluding certain items, climbed 21 percent to $2.63 in the latest quarter, comfortably surpassing analysts' expectations Mold-Tek Packaging Q1 results: Net profit jumps 14 percent YoY to rupees 25.6 crore; revenue crosses rupees 300 crore. Mold-Tek Packaging reported a strong Q1 FY27, with net sales up 24.9 percent to rupees 300.45 crore and EBITDA growing by 19.1 percent . The company maintains confidence amid geopolitical challenges, focusing on pharmaceutical packaging and expanding its product portfolio while recovering from previous stock lows. China trains its guns on US warship replica. Satellite images show a structure resembling a US Navy Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer in the Taklamakan Desert in Xinjiang since at least June. Crude tumbles as US-Iran pause eases pressure, but risks to India's oil supply remain. Crude prices fell more than 9 percent after Washington and Tehran paused strikes, easing near-term pressure on India's import bill, even as risks around key shipping routes and Russian supplies persist. Tea, TVs, cars and apparel to get costlier in August. Consumer goods makers will raise prices in August for the third time this year. PE at 18! Small-cap stock hits 52-week high logging 14 percent intraday gain. Ratnaveer Precision Engineering shares surged over 14 percent post Q1 FY27 results, reflecting strong financial performance with 20 percent revenue growth. Strategic initiatives, including a CCL project, bolster market confidence. Small banks lure NRI deposits with high rates. Small and mid-sized Indian banks are ramping up FCNR(B) deposit rates to attract non-resident Indians after interest rate deregulation, offering returns above 7.4–7.5 percent without leverage benefits. Wall Street edges higher as oil prices slide after US-Iran hostilities pause, Microsoft climbs 2.6 percent , Google gains 2.8 percent. As of 9:55 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 rose 0.6 percent , the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.7 percent Centre readies healthcare compliance overhaul. India plans major healthcare regulatory changes soon. Lohia Corp IPO subscribed over 7.25 times on final day; QIB portion booked 9 times. Lohia Corp's IPO was oversubscribed 7.26 times, with significant interest from qualified institutional buyers. The issue, with a price range of rupees 404-425 per share, aims for listing on July 30. The company reported strong revenue growth, reaching rupees 1,716.99 crore in FY26. Government proposes 3-yr PUCC validity for BS-VI vehicles. The Centre has proposed extending the validity of Pollution Under Control Certificates (PUCC) for BS-VI private vehicles up to six years old from one year to three years, while introducing a staggered renewal schedule based on vehicle age and emission norms to reduce compliance burden and reflect cleaner vehicle technology. Global Fuel Markets Are Out of Slack as Wars Push Prices Higher. Massive metal towers rising more than 100 feet are pumping out gasoline, diesel and jet fuel at break-neck rates around the world. Those refineries now have little margin for error. Tata flies over losses to log a rupees 31,961 crore profit. Tata Sons reported a 22 percent rise in FY26 standalone profit to rupees 31,961 crore, driven by investment gains and stronger portfolio earnings. US stock market today: S and P 500, Nasdaq futures jump up to 1.7 percent as oil prices tumble on easing US-Iran tensions. Stock futures climbed on 27 July following a decline in oil prices amid reduced US-Iran tensions. With investors looking to the tech sector for earnings reports, expectations rise for a potential ceasefire. The Federal Reserve's upcoming meeting also garners attention this week. India moves to China-proof infra after TBM shock. India is accelerating efforts to localise mining and construction equipment manufacturing after Chinese export delays disrupted supplies of tunnel boring machines (TBMs) for key infrastructure projects. Hindustan Zinc share: Jefferies, HSBC to Nuvama , brokerages see big upside. Should you buy?. Hindustan Zinc's strong June-quarter earnings bolster long-term growth confidence. Analysts cite favorable pricing for zinc and silver, low production costs, and expanding projects, prompting brokerages like YES Securities and Jefferies to upgrade targets and maintain 'Buy' ratings. CWG: Weightlifter Bindyarani Devi clinches Bronze. Bindyarani Devi won bronze in the women's 58kg weightlifting event. NBFC stock Aye Finance falls 3 percent on profit booking; JM Financial, IIFL Capital give buy calls after Q1 results. On a monthly scale, the stock is now nearly 4 percent down so far in July, looking set to snap its three-month winning streak. From April to June, the stock clocked a solid cumulative gain of 82 percent .

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. NRIs can now buy term insurance in USD from India: Policybazaar explains how new plan protects against currency risk. Non-Resident Indians can now purchase US dollar-denominated term insurance plans in India. These plans are available through Policybazaar's partner insurers at GIFT City. Premiums and claim payouts will be processed in US dollars, addressing currency depreciation risks. This initiative allows global Indians to access internationally aligned financial products within India. SEBI proposes MF-only PMS with rupees 25 lakh entry: Expert explains how it differs from traditional PMS. The proposed MF-only PMS framework is positioned as a bridge between self-managed mutual fund investing and traditional PMS, allowing investors to access professional portfolio management at a lower entry threshold of rupees 25 lakh while remaining within regulated investment products. Homebuyer booked flat for rupees 18 lakh in 2010, later finds builder sold the flats to third party: Mumbai man wins full refund with interest, penalty on developer. Homebuyer wins full rupees 18 lakh refund in Mumbai: While the developer issued an allotment letter dated August 16, 2010, it failed to provide possession to the buyer. In view of the delay, the homebuyer had approached Maharashtra RERA seeking relief. The authority had on April 24, 2025, ordered the relief of possession to the homebuyer. He again filed a review seeking refund of the amount. More than 570 people reported income over rupees 100 crore in FY26, 4x growth in billionaires over 5 years: MoS to Lok Sabha. ITR: India has seen 4x growth in billionaires in five years. As many as 576 people reported gross total income of rupees 100 crore or more, FY26 income-tax filings showed, MoS Pankaj Chaudhary said today. File your ITR for just rupees 11: Paytm partners with ClearTax; here's how you can file income tax return. ITR filing: Paytm users can now file Income Tax Returns directly through the app. This service is available starting at an affordable price of eleven rupees. The company partnered with ClearTax to offer a quicker online filing process. CBDT's new crypto reporting guidance explained: What it means for digital asset investors and taxpayers. The CBDT has issued a guidance note to operationalise India's crypto-asset reporting framework in line with the OECD's global standards. While there is no change in crypto taxation, experts say investors should focus on accurate record-keeping as information sharing becomes more structured. Filing income-tax returns? Here's how to calculate your ITR dues under new tax regime and old tax regime. Want to complete filing your income-tax returns before the 31 July deadline? Here's how taxpayers can calculate their ITR dues under new tax regime and old tax regime for financial year 2026 / AY 2027. Save income tax when filing ITR for AY 2026-2027 by claiming Section 54 or 54F benefits if you sold land, house property or equity shares; Know how. Indian taxpayers can claim capital gains tax exemptions by reinvesting sale proceeds. Section 54 and 54F allow exemptions for residential property sales and other assets. Specific timelines and conditions must be met for claiming these tax benefits. Unutilised amounts must be deposited in the Capital Gains Account Scheme. What 20 years of market data reveals about large-, mid- and small-caps and why India's economic outlook matters. Mid- and small-caps often face criticism during market corrections, but 20 years of data show they have consistently outperformed large-caps in strong market years. Investors bullish on India's growth story should not ignore these segments despite their volatility. GST notice uploaded only on portal isn't valid service, high courts rule: What it means for taxpayers. High Courts are questioning GST notice validity when only uploaded online. Punjab and Haryana High Court ruled portal uploads are not valid service. Other High Courts also quashed notices due to improper tab placement. Taxpayers must now regularly check the GST portal for any notices. DA hike: Inflation-linked wage, DA merger, new formula, here are Dearness Allowance-related demands of employee groups. DA hike: Here are the key Dearness Allowance-related demands made by employee groups , from demand for an inflation-linked wage model to calls for implementation of DA merger and a new calculation formula for the component. rupees 17.41 lakh penalty for ITR filing mistake: CA firm's owner's affidavit helps taxpayer get relief in ITAT Mumbai; know how. rupees 17.41 lakh penalty imposed due to error in ITR filed by junior staff in CA firm; Here's how affidavit from the CA firm's owner helps taxpayer get relief from penalty in ITAT Mumbai. Know how taxpayer won case in ITAT Mumbai UPI-linked PF claim settlement facility rollout delayed: Expected launch timeline and key benefits for EPFO members. EPFO has delayed the launch of its UPI-linked claim settlement facility to August as it focuses on resolving glitches in the upgraded CITES 2.01 portal. The new system aims to enable faster credit of eligible PF claims through UPI once the platform stabilises. ITR filing last date: Will Income Tax Department extend July 31 deadline for FY 25-26? Here's what experts say. ITR filing deadline: The July 31 income tax return deadline approaches with many taxpayers yet to file. Experts are divided on whether the government will extend the filing deadline. Some believe the portal is functioning smoothly and an extension is unlikely. Others suggest a short extension might be granted if glitches persist. 8th pay commission: Panel set to hold meetings in Delhi, Chennai, Puducherry in August and September , Check full list. The 8th pay commission panel is scheduled to hold state and union territory visits and meetings in Delhi, Chennai, and Puducherry in August and September this year as part of its consultation process. Check the full list of cities, dates and other details here... EPF versus mutual funds: Which is better for retirement? EPFO compares returns, tax, pension benefits and risk. The Employees Provident Fund offers retirement security and employer contributions. Mutual funds are voluntary investments with market-linked returns and potential capital gains tax. EPF provides additional benefits like pension and life insurance coverage. Mutual fund beneficiaries receive only the investment value upon death. Different fund categories, same stocks? These equity mutual funds have up to 79.4 percent portfolio overlap. A study found that the BOI Large and Mid Cap Fund and BOI Multi Cap Fund from the same AMC have a portfolio overlap of 79.4 percent , despite belonging to different categories. This highlights that investing in multiple equity mutual funds across categories may not always lead to better diversification. Building your first mutual fund portfolio at 25? Experts share the ideal allocation and common mistakes to avoid. Experts say investors aged 25-30 should focus on goal-based asset allocation rather than chasing returns. Here's how to allocate equity, debt and gold, and the mistakes to avoid. Gold rate today (July 27, 2026): Check 24k, 22k, 20k and 18k gold jewellery prices from IBJA, Joyalukkas, Tanishq, Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold and Diamonds in Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, other cities. Gold rate today: Gold prices saw an increase on Monday, July 27, 2026, across major cities. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association provided indicative rates for various gold purities. Consumers should check current rates before purchasing gold jewellery. Can a salaried person use presumptive tax for rupees 1 lakh freelance income?. Whether you can opt for presumptive taxation under section 44ADA of the Act depends on the nature of your freelance income. If your freelance work qualifies as a specified profession you may opt for the presumptive taxation scheme, as gross receipts of rupees 1 lakh are within the prescribed thresholds. ITR filing mistake: ITAT deletes rupees 17.41 lakh penalty after CA firm's affidavit proves clerical error. The Mumbai ITAT deleted a rupees 17.41 lakh penalty after accepting a CA firm's affidavit that an incorrect revised ITR was filed due to a clerical error. The Tribunal held that, in the absence of evidence of deliberate misreporting, penalty under Section 270A could not be sustained. ITR filing issue, refund delay or TDS mismatch? Here's how to raise a complaint through e-Nivaran. The e-Nivaran facility allows taxpayers to raise and track income tax grievances online through a structured process. Both registered and unregistered users can raise complaints, which are routed to the concerned department, and can be tracked using a unique acknowledgement number. EPF Calculator: rupees 25,000 basic pay can build corpus of over rupees 1.12 crore in 30 years – Here's how. An employee earning a basic salary of rupees 25,000 can accumulate an estimated EPF corpus of rupees 1.12 crore over 30 years. Monthly contributions, annual salary hikes and the power of compounding together build long-term retirement wealth through the Employees' Provident Fund. 8th Pay Commission latest news: 8th CPC to hold meetings in Chennai and Puducherry in September; check dates. 8th Pay Commission news: The 8th Pay Commission will hold stakeholder meetings in Chennai on September 7 and 8. Discussions in Puducherry are scheduled for September 9, with appointments closing August 18. Central government employee associations in Delhi met on August 7 and 10. The commission is gathering suggestions on pay, pension, and work conditions.

transcript.title: Science and technology
